cues: A worked example on limiting factors.
A rice plant at twenty degrees in bright sunlight.
Doubling the light changes nothing, but raising carbon dioxide to eight hundred parts per million doubles the rate.
What is limiting, and what happens if we then warm it to thirty degrees?
